# Constructed rhetorical probes

Backups are not a **checkbox**. They are your last line of defense. Monitoring is not a dashboard. It is the foundation of operational confidence. Testing is not a phase. It is a commitment to quality. <!-- want "syntax.repeated-reframing" -->

## Code operands

`Backup()` isn't a checkbox; it's a safeguard. `Monitor()` isn't a dashboard; it's a commitment. <!-- want "syntax.repeated-reframing" -->

## Source-bound Ptah clause

This page defines all four; other pages link here instead of redefining them. <!-- want "filler.document-metadiscourse" -->

## Announcements

In this guide, we will explain the `--dev-url` option. The following chapters describe recovery. <!-- want "filler.document-metadiscourse" -->

## Technical controls

A dev database is not the target. It is a disposable replay target.

See the configuration reference for the complete list of environment variables.

The client must not retry. It is a safety constraint. The server must not cache. It is a privacy constraint.

Backups retain database contents. Monitoring reports replication lag. Testing checks retry behavior.
